entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4356298849169862784: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 79882: distance 32.637 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.007), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 32.637 +/- 0.228 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 30.5136 +/- 0.1878 mas (same row, RUWE 3.47), 162.4 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 83.916, 40.763 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 4356298849169862784 (quality A), from 2018A&A...616A...7S; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 10.019 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 79882: radius 10.019 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 54.942 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.051) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4968 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 79882: effective temperature 4968 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.044).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1): Alekseeva et al. (1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Yed Posterior is HR 6075., cross-checked against Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 746: HR 6075; VizieR III/202 (4 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe5c3. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 146791 is not in the library; kiehling: HR 6075 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: found, not needed after the color and its cross-check; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,968 K and log g 2.77 (u1 0.637, u2 0.141): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.77 from 2021MNRAS.505.4496G; the 15 published values span log g 2.44 to 3.03, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness.
